findings.location: ...dissipline 'n negatiewe konnotasie, wat hopelik nie sal struikelblokkeer dat die leser aangetrek word tot wat broer Donald deel nie.
findings.source_quote: For many, discipline carries a negative connotation, which hopefully will not interfere with the reader being drawn to what Brother Donald has to share.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the unidiomatic/incorrect Afrikaans verb 'struikelblokkeer' to a clear phrase. For example: "wat hopelik nie sal verhoed dat die leser aangetrokke word tot wat broer Donald deel nie." Preserve original HTML and punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: For many carries a negative connotation, which hopefully will not struikelblokkeer that the reader be drawn to what brother Donald shares.

findings.location: Broer Joe Tindall was 'n raadsraadslid vir The Berean Voice sedert ons begin in Junie 2016.
findings.source_quote: Brother Joe Tindall has been a board member for The Berean Voice since our beginning in June of 2016.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the duplicated word and keep the present-perfect sense implied by the English. For example: "Broer Joe Tindall was sedert ons begin in Junie 2016 'n raadsraadslid van The Berean Voice." or better: "Broer Joe Tindall is sedert ons begin in Junie 2016 'n raadsraadslid van The Berean Voice." Preserve the paragraph tag and surrounding HTML.
findings.translation_quote: Broer Joe Tindall was 'n raadsraadslid vir The Berean Voice sedert ons begin in Junie 2016.
